data.title: Vinicius Jr: Real Madrid forward says Arsenal interest has affected form - BBC Sport
data.content:
Vinicius received a red card for violent conduct in October when he pulled the hair of Villarreal midfielder Nathan Saliba, which led to a four-match suspension.

In his absence, record signing Yan Diomande has made the most of his opportunity on the left wing, scoring four goals.

Vinicius joined Real from Brazilian side Flamengo in 2018 and has scored more than 20 club goals in each of his past five seasons. [...] Mourinho's side are second in La Liga, three points behind rivals Barcelona, and return to league action when they host Celta Vigo on Saturday.

## More on this story

Red card, suspension and a conspiracy - what's up with Vini Jr?

Following Real Madrid's win against Roma, Vinicius said: "I'm aware of my form and how I'm playing. I'm here to help the team"

Norway's Erling Haaland celebrates scoring against Brazil

## Shorts [...] "Being knocked out so early was something we hadn't expected. So, I took advantage of my holidays to enjoy myself, rest, relax, and spend more time with my family. I ended up training less than in previous years.

"That may have affected my start to the season.

"On top of that, regarding my contract renewal, with so many clubs showing interest last summer, I felt truly overwhelmed, as with the situation at Real Madrid. But it's a very long season."
